mapper.select: SELECT goal_id AS goalId, user_id AS userId, name AS name, target_amount AS targetAmount, current_amount AS currentAmount FROM goals WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}

SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS name, SUM(t.amount) AS monthlyAmount FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(t.occurred_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(t.occurred_at) = #{month} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY monthlyAmount DESC LIMIT 1
